Harper: Heads-up — payments-sampleapp just reported duplicate charge callbacks when a long /complete-payment got a 429 while our token rotated AND the CDN retried a 502. Its a weird 3-way race. Anyone seen CDN + token-rotate + client retry lead to duplicate side-effects?

Zoe: Yikes. Which SDK and which quickstart flow? Streams or single-shot?

Harper: Single-shot HTTP from Go SDK quickstart. Repro steps: start long request, trigger token rotate, CDN returns 502 which it retries once, server eventually returns 429 to one path, client retries immediately. Result: two webhook posts. Logs: 
```
[3167778888] start op id=pay-42
[3167778890] upstream: 502 (cdn retried=1)
[3167778891] server: 429 Retry-After: 0.35
[3167778891] client retry attempt=1 delay=0ms (Go SDK)
[3167778892] token rotate old=tokA new=tokB
[3167778894] webhook posted id=pay-42
[3167778894] webhook posted id=pay-42 (duplicate)
```

Matt: Two immediate problems: (1) CDN opaque retrying can duplicate requests when theres no idempotency header; (2) Go SDK is rounding/clamping Retry-After poorly (0.35 -> 0).

Zoe: Agree. Short-term mitigations: set CDN to NOT retry on /v1/* POSTs that are side-effecting, and have the SDK add X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key automatically for HTTP flows (UUID per logical op). Also parse Retry-After as float and apply a minimum 100ms clamp + jitter.

Matt: For backoff, instead of classic exponential jitter, Im leaning to decorrelated jitter to reduce synchronized retries under heavy load. Example (JS pseudocode):
```js
function decorrelatedJitter(prev, base=100, cap=10000) {
  const t = Math.min(cap, Math.random() * (prev * 3) + base);
  return Math.round(t);
}
// prev is previous delay (start with base)
```
// When Retry-After present: delay = Math.max(Math.round(parsedRetryAfter*1000), decorrelatedJitter(prev))

Harper: Good call. Also we need parity: Node/Go/Python must behave the same. I noticed Go quickstart included a naive fetch-retry snippet without idempotency in README — we should update that.

Zoe: Also propose a small server-side safeguard: if request includes X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key, backend should dedupe by op-id across tokens/instances for a short safe window, and log collisions. That helps when proxies or CDNs replay.

DevX Bot: Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/retries — added a subsection "CDN/proxy blind retries + token rotation". Issue RD-12177 opened for SDK parity and CDN config guidance.

infra-bot: Filed INF-1222: "Disable CDN automatic retry for /v1/generate and /v1/complete-payment; honor idempotency headers upstream". PR ready for review.

Matt: Action items: (1) Go SDK: parse fractional Retry-After, clamp min 100ms, implement default decorrelated jitter backoff + auto-idempotency header (opt-out) — I'll open a PR. (2) Update quickstart README to show idempotency & explain CDN caveats (Harper). (3) Infra: apply INF-1222 to CDN rules (infra team). (4) Backend: add short-lived dedupe cache keyed by idempotency key (backend team). (5) QA: run staging with CDN retry disabled and idempotency enabled to verify duplicate rate near 0.

Harper: I'll coordinate the staging run once infra PR lands. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
